responsibility_edges.evidence: TargetProofBinding is an independently versioned, sha-pinned cross-repo contract (keystone header; binding_version const 1); compile consumes it, never defines it.
target_observation block rides CodeRunEvidence, versioned with the keystone (packet 03 §4); promotion parses, never authors the shape.
Parnas cut: the reject-code catalog, fence, and freshness constants change independently of comparison logic (RB-1, OQ-7 rulings changed them without touching validators).
Same catalog/fence dependency as E-3; finalize imports codes and mode, defines neither.
Custody codes and budget constants are catalog entries; CUSTODY_BUDGET_BREACH was added 2026-09-14 without ledger logic changing.
self_check_plan mirrors Fizzy's PLAN_SCHEMA_VERSION_TYPE_INVALID from the catalog (abe2040). Consumer is the emitter's self-check (C-1 split).
The owner cannot author observations; runner receipts are the trusted side (packet 03 §4 'produced by the runner'; TC-5.3 owner-authored rejected).
tmr-registry.json is compile's state authority; promotion reads validated records and never writes bindings (tmr_compile_step.py owns the registry).
authority-paths.json is census state hashed into the architecture fingerprint; cutover planning consumes the current→target delta (packet 04 §2.2-2.3).
Phase 7 creates the custody budget and expected rows (packet 04 §3 Phase 7); the ledger is the state authority for rows.
Removal-preview validation is a distinct FAILURE authority (verdict only; execution out of scope per R-11) from ledger accounting; C-3 corrected the kind from effect to failure-authority.
Receipt authority is the runner (R-5); reconciliation reads partial/absent receipts at session start and must not infer a result (TC-14.1). Direction corrected per C-4.
ORACLE consumes bound obligations from the registry; it never edits bindings (DECISIONS D-2).
Parnas cut: prompt text changes per model generation; oracle logic is code (D-2 table: guardrail prompts vs mechanical predicates).
Census is supplied read-only to seats (packet 04 §3 Phase 5); seats cannot mutate it; the broker answers per path.
The harness consumes the policy-owned enum to measure catalog coverage (TC-10.2); direction corrected per C-5.
Harness calls the validator's public surface (fixture → codes) only; E.4 rule: every test runs against every candidate unmodified.
Same public-surface contract as E-17 for validate_authority_paths.
Same for build_cutover_obligations / self_check_plan.
Same for validate_custody_close.
Readiness probes the sha tripwire read-only and never repairs (TC-0.1); docs/CLI change independently of the contract.
Readiness runs the targeted suites as a control edge; harness content changes independently.
R-4 provenance, R-6 comparison, R-18 diagnostics share one failure authority (the promotion verdict) and one input (the receipt); no state/effect/trust boundary between them.
R-10 rows, budget, dispositions, close all write the same ledger under one lock; splitting would create two state authorities for one file.
C-1: dependency-semantics.json (R-8) and fizzy-plan.json (R-9) are two state authorities; D0.2 split rule. Obligations are produced first and consumed by emission.
R-7 trigger evaluation and census authoring/validation are one artifact's lifecycle.
R-11 preview and R-12 reconciliation both decide 'may dependent work proceed' over the same rows; one effect authority.
C-6: Phase 7 projects TMR target bindings into task verification metadata (packet 04 section 3 Phase 7); registry is compile's state.
C-7: seats receive target-bound tests (packet 04 section 3 Phase 5, line 145); registry state supplied read-only.
C-8: active-vs-legacy classification must link to the census path role (packet 04 section 3 Phase 6).
C-9: the runner emits the versioned CodeRunEvidence.target_observation payload (tmr_schema.py CodeRunEvidence); the contract must reach the producer, not only the consumer.
C-10: validate_authority_paths emits catalog codes (roadmap architecture_impact.consumed_by).
C-11: preview validation emits CUSTODY_DESTRUCTIVE_PREVIEW_INCOMPLETE from the catalog.
C-12: ASP-HARDEN-002 replays against the finalize-owned assertion-vs-schema validator (packet 04 section 5.3).
C-1 follow-on: self_check_plan corpus (ASP-HARDEN-009/010) runs against the emitter's public surface.
